biotools.summary: phylotypr is an R package implementing the Naive Bayesian classifier for classifying DNA sequences, particularly 16S rRNA gene sequences, to taxonomic lineages. It leverages the Ribosomal Database Project and other databases for taxonomic information and is designed for microbial ecologists.
